name: Twinkle ☆ Crusaders -Passion Star Stream-
original_name: ティンクル☆くるせいだーす -Passion Star Stream-
source:
This is a fandisc to Twinkle ☆ Crusaders, comprising several scenarios.

Venus Embryo is a sequel to the original story and adds two new heroines: Lullshare and Illear.

The Queen of Witches is a crossover with [url=/v1072]Princess Witches[/url].

Ku RUKU-ru! is about a new character, Shel, trying to get Synn to hook up with the heroines.

After Stories include after stories for Melilot and Amyrina, a scenario with the Seven Great Demon Generals, and the scenarios from [url=/v1478]Twinkle ☆ Crusaders - Miracle Disc[/url].

Lastly, Naze Nani KuruKuru briefly presents the characters and story of the original game.
translation:
本作是《Twinkle☆Crusaders》的Fan Disk，由多个剧本组成。

《Venus Embryo》是原作故事的续篇，并新增露露希雅与伊莉亚两名女主角。

《The Queen of Witches》是与[url=/v1072]《Princess Witches》[/url]的联动剧本。

《Ku RUKU-ru!》讲述新角色谢尔试图撮合新与女主角们。

《After Stories》包括梅莉洛特与艾米莉娜的后日谈、七大魔将登场的剧本，以及[url=/v1478]《Twinkle☆Crusaders - Miracle Disc》[/url]中的剧本。

最后，《Naze Nani KuruKuru》会简要介绍原作的角色和故事。
